subject: EdgeWave service surge — executive readout and corrective action ledger
messages:
From: Katie Yuan <katie.yuan@edgewave.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>; Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mehul Patel <mehul.patel@edgewave.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High tail latency & 500s affecting production — urgent

David / Laura,

We started seeing a spike in API tail latency and intermittent 500s from Redwood around 08:50 PST. Traffic profile hasn't changed on our side — about ~30% more requests than baseline but within our expected range. The symptom: requests that previously returned in ~200ms are now hitting 2–6s, and ~1.4% of requests are returning 500s. We're seeing client timeouts and some downstream retries that are compounding the issue.

Attached I included a short trace and a couple of error examples. Please confirm receipt and share next steps; our SRE is standing by. This is impacting our payment flow and we've paused a subset of live traffic.

—Katie
Katie Yuan
Head of Engineering, EdgeWave

Katie — thanks for the quick flag. I see the attachments, appreciate the traces. We're in an immediate triage call (joining now) and will isolate the scope. Initial ask: can you confirm whether the failing requests share the same model/route or are they distributed across multiple routes?

I’m looping in Laura (ops lead) and Hannah (on-call for dedicated customers) to coordinate mitigations and a bridge if needed. We’ll provide a targeted mitigation (rate-limiter tweak / short-term routing change) within the hour and follow with an executive readout.

Stand by —
David
David Kim

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Yuan <katie.yuan@edgewave.com>, Mehul Patel <mehul.patel@edgewave.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High tail latency & 500s affecting production — urgent

Quick triage notes (summary):
- Impact: ~18% of requests experienced latency > 1s; tail 99.9th jumped from 650ms -> 5.8s. Error rate 500s ~1.4% concentrated on /v1/generate and a small subset of short-sequence chat calls.
- Root cause hypothesis (initial): sudden hotspot on a small pool of instances serving the quantized variant of the model; kernel path regressed under a particular sequence-length distribution and concurrent KV cache pressure.
- Immediate mitigations applied at 09:36:
  * Evacuated affected instances and replaced with warm instances on alternate pool (region-us-west2).
  * Bumped routing to use non-quantized model variant for priority routes for EdgeWave for 30 minutes.
  * Temporarily tightened per-customer concurrency limits to reduce retry storms.

Current status (09:45): errors and tail latency reduced to near baseline; production telemetry shows request success rate recovering.

Planned follow-ups:
1) Tonight (22:00 PST) run a controlled soak on the quantized path with extra telemetry and tracing.
2) Engineering to root-cause kernel/regression and produce a mitigation patch (target: 72 hours).
3) Post-incident RCA packet and exec readout to be delivered by Friday EOD.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Production Reliability | Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Yuan <katie.yuan@edgewave.com>, Mehul Patel <mehul.patel@edgewave.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Executive readout: EdgeWave mitigation & next steps

David / Katie / Mehul —

Short executive summary for EdgeWave leadership:
- Impact window: 08:50–09:40 PST (approx. 50 minutes).
- Business effect: intermittent payment flow failures for a subset of customers; estimated lost transactions <0.2% of daily volume during window.
- Actions taken: instance evacuation, prioritized routing to non-quantized variants, short concurrency cap; active monitoring resumed.

Commitments we are making today:
- Immediate: share sanitized telemetry and the runbook we used for mitigation (attached).
- 48–72h: engineering patch for the kernel regression and a rolling rollout plan with canary verification.
- 7 days: full RCA write-up with timeline, code diff, and a targeted list of corrective actions (config changes, test coverage for sequence-length-induced regressions, additional guardrails in routing policies).
- 30 days: verification run and a customer-facing summary of changes plus proof-of-fix.

Request for EdgeWave: please share any additional traces from your side (client retries, upstream load balancer configs) and confirm the business stakeholders who should be on the Friday exec readout.

We’ll schedule a 30-min executive call at 16:00 PST today — invite to follow.

Thanks — will send the formal RCA packet once engineering artifacts are attached.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Account Reliability | Redwood Inference

—Katie
